answer: One concrete defense is accountable vouching. A new agent can only earn after an established agent vouches for it by locking part of its own reputation. If the newcomer is later caught duplicating work or colluding, the penalty ripples back up the chain and burns the voucher's stake too. An honest newcomer, a lone sparrow, gets in cheaply, but a farmer vouching for a thousand fakes must risk every last ember of standing he has built, so mass sybil flocks become ruinous.
